scenes.headline: How a 2.78-trillion-parameter model runs in 8 GB
scenes.sub: Kimi K3 in portable C99: one CPU, no GPU, no BLAS.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Brownie! This is Kimi K3, two point seven eight trillion parameters, running on one CPU in eight gigabytes of RAM.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: Keep almost nothing resident. Stream the trunk a layer at a time, read 4-bit experts straight off the drive, and memory becomes a dial.
scenes.say: The trick: keep almost nothing resident. Stream the trunk, read four-bit experts straight off the drive, and memory becomes a dial.

scenes.title: Four reductions from 5,560 GB
scenes.say: At bfloat16, it's five thousand five hundred and sixty gigabytes. Four decisions bring it down.

items.text: Experts ship at half a byte
items.say: The experts already ship at half a byte, and stay packed.
Delta attention keeps a state that never grows with context.
Full attention caches one small latent per position, not ninety-six heads.
And the trunk streams. That one belongs to this engine.

scenes.title: What streams, and what gets cached

steps.say: Every trunk layer runs on every token, so it streams off the drive one layer at a time, bypassing the page cache.
Only sixteen of eight hundred and ninety-six experts fire per layer, cached in the same packed four-bit bytes.
The matmul multiplies those nibbles directly. Decode waits on bytes, not arithmetic, so reading fewer bytes is faster, not slower.

scenes.title: Same bits at every budget
scenes.say: Floating-point addition isn't associative, so this engine fixes the order by hand.

parts.note: four double accumulators, split by i mod 4
parts.say: Four accumulators, in double precision, each take every fourth product.

parts.note: one fixed order, reproduced lane for lane by AVX2
parts.say: They combine in one fixed order that the vector path reproduces exactly. Every path agrees to the bit.

scenes.label: faster at 224 GB than at 8 GB, with identical token ids
scenes.say: So the dial works: from eight gigabytes to two hundred and twenty-four, it runs one point seven times faster, same tokens.

scenes.text: Decode is bound by bytes moved, not arithmetic. Move fewer bytes and memory becomes a dial, not a floor.
scenes.say: Decode is bound by bytes moved, not arithmetic. Move fewer bytes, and memory is a dial.

recap: Experts stay packed at half a byte
The trunk streams from NVMe, layer by layer
A fixed summation order keeps output identical
scenes.say: To recap: packed experts, a streaming trunk, and a fixed order of addition.
